findings.title: Misleading error
findings.text: When `--fail-on-flag` is passed with any additional argument (`req canon --fail-on-flag extra`, `req canon --fail-on-flag --verify`, or the flag twice), the guarded arm (`args.len() == 1`) does not match and the match falls through to `Some(other)`, printing `unrecognized flag: --fail-on-flag`. The exit code 2 is correct, but the message names the one valid flag as unrecognized and points the user at removing it instead of at the bad argument combination. The new `other_arguments_stay_usage_errors` test only asserts the usage line, so it does not catch this wording. Handle `Some("--fail-on-flag")` outside the guard (e.g. an "unexpected argument" arm) so the diagnostic names the actual problem.
